findings.rationale: The IAM policy sets Statement[0].Action to * rather than listing the specific AWS operations needed.
The IAM policy sets Statement[0].Resource to * instead of constraining access to specific ARNs or buckets.
The wildcard IAM statement is combined with an S3 bucket whose acl is public-read, creating a direct path from broad identity permissions to object exposure.
